paite: TOUPA aw, ka hon pahtawi ding a; nang na hon domsang a hon doute na hon otkhumsak louh ziak in.
heading: David La / Kipahthu Genna Thumna
english: A Psalm. A Song for the Dedication of the Temple. By David. I will extol you, Yahweh, for you have raised me up, and have not made my foes to rejoice over me.

paite: TOUPA ka Pathian aw, ka hon sam a, nang na hon hihdamta hi.
english: Yahweh my God, I cried to you, and you have healed me.

paite: TOUPA aw, nang ka hinna Sheol a kipan na pikhia a; kokhuk a ka paisuk louhna ding in nang na hon humhing zel hi.
english: Yahweh, you have brought up my soul from Sheol. You have kept me alive, that I should not go down to the pit.

paite: Amisiangthoute aw, TOUPA phat in la sa unla, amin siangthou phat un.
english: Sing praise to Yahweh, you saints of his. Give thanks to his holy name.

paite: Ahehna mitphiat kal lel ahi a; adeihsakna ah hinna a-om hi; kahna zan khat sung lel ahi a, himahleh zingsang in nopna ahong tung nak hi.
english: For his anger is but for a moment. His favor is for a lifetime. Weeping may stay for the night, but joy comes in the morning.

paite: Ke'n zaw nuam ka sak lai in, chik mah chiang in ka ling kei ding, ka chi hi.
english: As for me, I said in my prosperity, “I shall never be moved.”

paite: TOUPA nang na deihsakna ziak in ka tang na dingkipsakta a; himahleh na mai na sel a, ka hong mangbangta hi.
english: You, Yahweh, when you favored me, made my mountain stand strong; but when you hid your face, I was troubled.

paite: TOUPA aw, nang ka hon sam a; TOUPA kiang ah hehpihna ka ngen hi.
english: I cried to you, Yahweh. I made supplication to the Lord:

paite: Kokhuk a ka paisuk leh, ka sisan ah punna bang a om ding! Leivui in hon phat ding hia? Na thutak a gen sin maw?
english: “What profit is there in my destruction, if I go down to the pit? Shall the dust praise you? Shall it declare your truth?

paite: TOUPA aw, ngaikhia inla, ka tung ah zahngai in; TOUPA, nang hon panpihpa hi in.
english: Hear, Yahweh, and have mercy on me. Yahweh, be my helper.”

paite: Kei a ding in ka suunna, lamna na suaksak a; ka sai-ip puan na hon suahsak a, kipahna na hon tengsak hi.
english: You have turned my mourning into dancing for me. You have removed my sackcloth, and clothed me with gladness,

paite: Ka thupina dai nilouh lou a, nangmah phat a la asakna ding in TOUPA ka Pathian aw, tangtawn in kipahthu ka hon hilh gige ding hi.
english: to the end that my heart may sing praise to you, and not be silent. Yahweh my God, I will give thanks to you forever!
